verdict.rationale: Solid supports Resources for server-loaded data used in Suspense-enabled UI, and full SSR with streaming/progressive hydration to pass data to interactive client components (solid-gh-3, solid-gh-4, solid-gh-12, solid-gh-14). However, evidence lacks specifics on async server components (as distinct from resources/SSR fetching) or explicit server-to-client data serialization patterns, and community feedback flags Suspense as a known pain point (solid-comm-12). Missing for 10: dedicated async server component API details, first-party docs/examples of server-fetch-then-hydrate pattern, independent verification of reliability beyond the flagged Suspense issues.
